name: Mukatsuku Imouto o Kusuri de Nemurasete Itazura Shite Yatta
original_name: ムカつく妹を薬で眠らせてイタズラしてやった
source:
Little sister Karina is always insulting her big brother, who responds finally by putting a roofie in her juice.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ139310.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
妹妹香里奈总是辱骂哥哥，哥哥终于作出报复，在她的果汁里下了迷药。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ139310.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英语页面[/url]]
